field.label: Enabled
field.help: Enable or disable this site-to-site connection.

field.label: Site Name
field.help: A unique name for this site-to-site connection (alphanumeric, dash, underscore, max 64 characters).

field.label: Instance
field.help: The local WireGuard instance (wg0, wg1, …) this peer is attached to.

field.label: Peer Public Key
field.help: The WireGuard public key of the remote site. Obtain this from the remote firewall's WireGuard instance.

field.label: Pre-shared Key
field.help: Optional symmetric pre-shared key for additional post-quantum resistance. Must match on both sides.

field.label: Endpoint Address
field.help: Public IP address or hostname of the remote site. Leave empty if the remote site is roaming (initiates only).

field.label: Endpoint Port
field.help: UDP port the remote WireGuard instance listens on. Defaults to 51820.

field.label: Remote Subnets
field.help: Subnets reachable through this peer in CIDR notation (e.g. 10.10.0.0/24). WireGuard will only route traffic to these prefixes through this tunnel. Enter each network and press Enter.

field.label: Keepalive Interval
field.help: Send a keepalive packet every N seconds to keep NAT mappings alive. 25 seconds is recommended for most NAT devices. Leave empty to disable.
